502:t_2:14.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「I have heard of $$クロノ$$ as well. And that even now, the fighting over $$ラプラスの箱$$ goes on.」

502:t_2:15.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Do you know the truth about $$ラプラスの箱$$?」

502:t_2:17.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Why would something that existed in one of the worlds that make up the $$ＵＣＷ$$ have any meaning in the present world!?」

502:t_2:18.en:
$$リディ$$
「I thought so too, until I learned its true meaning...」

502:t_2:20.en:
$$リディ$$
「If it were only the surface meaning of the Box, then even if it were made public, it could be hushed up. But...」

502:t_2:21.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$... What do you know?」

502:t_2:22.en:
$$リディ$$
「The true meaning hidden in $$ラプラスの箱$$... Because I learned it, I decided to pilot that unit.」

502:t_2:23.en:
$$リディ$$
「To protect this world... and humanity.」

502:t_3:5.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Are you okay!? If you're alive, answer me!」

502:t_3:8.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「If you're looking for $$ヒイロ$$, he's right here.」

502:t_3:10.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「He boarded this ship in a battered $$ガンダム$$ and rushed to my side...」

502:t_3:11.en:
$$ノイン$$
「No wonder. After everything he did.」

502:t_3:12.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Waiting until he confirmed the mission was complete is so like $$ヒイロ$$.」

502:t_3:13.en:
$$五飛$$
「Asleep like this, even he looks kind of cute.」

502:t_3:16.en:
$$カトル$$
「The Heart of Space... It's $$ヒイロ$$, isn't it?」

502:t_3:18.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Those were $$ヒイロ・ユイ#pilot$$'s words.」

502:t_3:19.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The leader of the colony liberation movement that $$ヒイロ$$'s code name came from...」

502:t_3:20.en:
$$五飛$$
「The meaning of the Heart of Space that he spoke of in his speech is still debated to this day.」

502:t_3:21.en:
$$カトル$$
「But this is what I think. That someone cares for someone, their hearts connect because of it, and they can even risk their lives for it...」

502:t_3:22.en:
$$カトル$$
「That is what gives humans the strength to live in this vast, cold universe.」

502:t_3:23.en:
$$カトル$$
「The moment we become able to do that will surely mean that humanity has truly become a species that lives in space.」

502:t_3:24.en:
$$キラ$$
「The heart the universe asks of humans... huh.」

502:t_3:25.en:
$$デュオ$$
「I see. Put that way, it makes sense.」

502:t_3:26.en:
$$五飛$$
「And $$ヒイロ$$ is the one who embodies it...」

502:t_3:28.en:
$$刹那$$
「This is the first time I've seen $$ヒイロ$$ this defenseless.」

502:t_3:29.en:
$$シン$$
「Even so, $$キラ$$...! Taking a picture is...!」

502:t_3:30.en:
$$キラ$$
「Is that bad? He was just so rare to see.」

502:t_3:31.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Let's keep it down. $$ヒイロ$$ finally fell asleep, and we'll wake him.」

502:t_3:34.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「We'll tow this ship all the way to $$ロンデニオン$$ ourselves.」

502:t_3:35.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$リリーナ$$... Look after $$ヒイロ$$ until then.」

502:t_3:38.en:
$$リリーナ$$
(Thank you, $$ヒイロ$$... You understand me. Just that gives me limitless courage.)

502:t_3:39.en:
$$リリーナ$$
(Rest easy, just for a little while. And when you wake up, let's move forward together again.)

502:t_3:40.en:
$$リリーナ$$
(Even if our paths differ, the place we're meant to reach is always the same...)

502:t_3:46.en:
$$リディ$$
「I'll say it once more. Unlock the $$バンシィ$$'s NT-D System.」

502:t_3:48.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$バナージ$$ has mastered it. I'll show you I can do it too.」

502:t_3:49.en:
$$リディ$$
「Besides, to capture $$マリーダ・クルス$$ with $c as our opponent, the $$バンシィ$$ as it is now lacks the power.」

502:t_3:50.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「...Understood. I'll send technicians over to you right away.」

502:t_3:51.en:
$$リディ$$
「Just mention $$マリーダ$$'s name and that's all it takes.」

502:t_3:52.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「$$リディ・マーセナス$$... True, you were the one who recovered the $$バンシィ$$ drifting in space, but...」

502:t_3:53.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Do not forget that I am the one who chose you as its pilot.」

502:t_3:54.en:
$$リディ$$
「You're not the one who chose me.」

502:t_3:58.en:
$$リディ$$
「It's meaningless talk for someone who was merely tacked onto the tail end of $$クロノ$$.」

502:t_3:59.en:
$$リディ$$
「Still, I can't understand it. Why are you so fixated on that enhanced human?」

502:t_3:61.en:
$$アルベルト$$
(If I had to say, perhaps I laid my own way of living over the fate of an enhanced human tossed around by other people's whims...)

502:t_3:62.en:
$$リディ$$
「...Whatever. Get the NT-D System done soon.」

502:t_3:64.en:
$$リディ$$
「One last time, I'm confirming. Destroying the $$ユニコーン$$ means killing your half-brother... $$バナージ$$.」

502:t_3:66.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「It's already a road stained with blood... In my family, the $$ビスト家$$, the killing among blood relatives goes on.」

502:t_3:67.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「My aunt $$マーサ$$ became so unyielding because her father, our grandfather, was killed by our great-grandfather $$サイアム$$.」

502:t_3:68.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Revenge on a world ruled by the logic of men... As a man, I can't simply accept that, but...」

502:t_3:69.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「To protect this world as well, we can't allow the $$ユニコーン$$ to exist.」

502:t_3:71.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「...Creating monsters like the $$ユニコーン$$ and the $$バンシィ$$, we're probably already standing at the doorstep of ruin...」

502:t_3:72.en:
$$リディ$$
(Wait for me, $$バナージ$$... Under the same conditions as you, I won't fall behind.)

502:t_3:73.en:
$$リディ$$
(Next time we meet, I'll settle things with you using the $$バンシィ$$'s true power...)
